hypothesis: After identical ex-ante risk controls, 12-1 factor-residual momentum contains incremental cross-sectional information beyond 12-1 raw momentum.
primary_signal: 12-1 residual momentum standardized by residual volatility
secondary_signal: 6-1 residual momentum standardized by residual volatility
portfolio_comparison: raw and residual arms receive identical beta/sector/gross/net/liquidity/volatility controls
primary_statistic: net spanning-regression alpha of residual arm conditional on raw arm
mechanism_statistic: paired cross-sectional IC difference: residual minus raw

inference.trial_accounting: two registered momentum specifications; DSR/multiple-testing adjustment required

precommitted_outcomes.A: alpha <= 0: stop residual momentum as an alpha transformation
precommitted_outcomes.B: alpha > 0 and delta Sharpe > 0: residual momentum may replace raw momentum
precommitted_outcomes.C: alpha > 0 and delta Sharpe < 0: keep raw core; allocate 25% of portfolio risk budget to incremental FactorStrip sleeve
precommitted_outcomes.D: alpha <= 0 and delta Sharpe > 0: portfolio engineering only; do not claim new alpha

holdout_rule: Do not run inferential alpha/Sharpe/IC evaluation on the clean PIT dataset until this design is formally registered in EdgeLab.
